_note: Pluggable GPU devices for tailor.py (--target KEY). The port flow uses only the facts (GPU, CPU, memory, software, layout) to brief the agent; nothing runs on the device. The optional GPU grader (tailor.py grade) uses site, partition, account, env and scratch: the r2 climb's four graded regions, one GPU per region, at the port's declared BUDGET_S, no network, scored on the Mac. Facts read 2026-11-17/18 (sinfo, qlimits, nvidia-smi in grading logs, pip list).

a100-nersc.name: NVIDIA A100 40 GB (NERSC Perlmutter)
a100-nersc.gpu: A100-SXM4 40 GB HBM2, Ampere sm_80, 4 per node, NVLink3
a100-nersc.cpu: AMD EPYC 7763 (Milan), 64 cores per node, x86_64
a100-nersc.python: 3.11.18, torch 2.11.0, triton 3.6.0, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, astropy 8.0.2, scikit-learn 1.9.1
a100-nersc.charge: 1 GPU node-hour per node-hour from the $NERSC_GPU_ACCOUNT pool (shared by 16 users)
a100-nersc.note: the r2 climb's own grader: the reference; tailoring here is what the climb already does

gb200-vista.name: NVIDIA GB200 (Blackwell, B200-class) on TACC Vista gb
gb200-vista.gpu: GB200 (Blackwell sm_100), 185 GB HBM3e each (189,471 MiB), 4 per node, all-to-all NVLink5 NV18 (~956 GB/s per GPU); GPU0-1 on NUMA 0, GPU2-3 on NUMA 1
gb200-vista.cpu: 2x NVIDIA Grace (Neoverse-V2), 144 cores per node, aarch64; NVLink-C2C CPU-GPU
gb200-vista.charge: 1 SU per node-hour (0.25 SU per GB200 GPU-hour), TACC 15-minute minimum; at most 2 running / 3 submitted gb jobs per user
gb200-vista.note: regions scen13 and scen10 are on Vista scratch; scen08 and scen14 must be staged (tailor/stage.py)

gh200-vista.name: NVIDIA GH200 (Hopper, H100-class) on TACC Vista gh
gh200-vista.gpu: GH200: H100 (Hopper sm_90) with 96 GB HBM3, 1 per node; NVLink-C2C to the Grace CPU (unified memory with 120 GB LPDDR5X)
gh200-vista.cpu: NVIDIA Grace (Neoverse-V2), 72 cores per node, aarch64
gh200-vista.charge: 1 SU per node-hour (= 1 SU per GH200 GPU-hour), TACC 15-minute minimum
gh200-vista.note: one job of 4 nodes, one region per node; same staging as gb200-vista

h100-ls6.name: NVIDIA H100 80 GB (TACC Lonestar6 gpu-h100)
h100-ls6.charge: 6 SU per node-hour (2 H100), TACC 15-minute minimum; qlimits: 1 node per job, 1 running / 4 submitted per user, only 4 nodes
h100-ls6.note: no dbt env and no regions on Lonestar6 yet (tailor/ls6_env.sh, tailor/stage.py); user namespaces (unshare -rn) fail on the login node and are untested on gpu-h100 compute nodes: the grader refuses to run without network isolation

h200.name: NVIDIA H200 141 GB
h200.note: no H200 in any of our allocations (NERSC, Vista, Lonestar6, Expanse expired, GCP VM has no GPU); slot kept for when one exists
